newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican exporters worry over peso strength - Marin.
newsitem.headline: Mexican exporters worry over peso strength - Marin.

text.p: Mexican exporters are worried about the strength of the peso and want the government to send clear signals to foreign exchange markets that it wants a competitive peso, a top export leader said Friday.

"Exporters want to see a tendency where it is very clearly seen that the exchange rate is competitive, not only right now but in the long run," Gilberto Marin Quintero, the chairman of the National Foreign Trade Council said.

"Of course, the exchange rate should not be the only factor to boost exports, productivity is important too. But we have a country cost that is different from competitors, such as financing, interest rates, infrastructure and security," Marin added.
